warning_text: GOVERNMENT WARNING: (1) ACCORDING TO THE SURGEON GENERAL, WOMEN SHOULD NOT DRINK ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES DURING PREGNANCY BECAUSE OF THE RISK OF BIRTH DEFECTS. (2) CONSUMPTION OF ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES IMPAIRS YOUR ABILITY TO DRIVE A CAR OR OPERATE MACHINERY, AND MAY CAUSE HEALTH PROBLEMS.
notes: Brand is spelled with a V for the U, 'SATVRNAL', on both faces; the back adds a registered-trademark symbol.
Net contents reads '1 LITRE', the British spelling, not 'LITER' or a millilitre figure.
Alcohol reads '46% ALC. BY VOL.' across two lines on the front, with a full stop after 'ALC' and after 'VOL'.
Front is set in a distressed display face; brand, alcohol and net contents were read from enlarged crops of the original image.
